excerpt.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
excerpt.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

texts.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
texts.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

texts.zh: 和星海帝国一起见鬼去吧！是时候复原星海共同体了！
texts.en: Down with the Imperium! It is time to bring back the old Galactic Community!

texts.zh: 就让你们的覆灭成为未来任何一个想要想星系内称王称霸的家伙们的教训吧。
texts.en: Let your downfall be a lesson to any future would-be tyrants who seek to rule the entire galaxy.

texts.zh: 你们可耻的社会构造——星海帝国——已经不复存在了。
texts.en: Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.
